output.reason: [ev-378d2524f6f6] says PR 6660 attached the new CRD view rules to the viewer aggregate role by mistake, and this PR moves them to the provider system role because the provider controller does not use the viewer role. PR 6660 ships in the same 2.0.0 release [ev-e4abe53a35a3]. So against the previous release, the net change is that the provider system role now grants CRD view rules: an addition, not a behavior change. "view" is not an RBAC verb and the evidence names no verbs, so the subject should be the resource name alone [ev-2d32fc322c30].

correction.statement: The Crossplane provider system role now includes view rules for customresourcedefinitions. These rules had been mistakenly added to the viewer aggregate role in the same release.
